sources.title: SargeDev/Solar-Decision-JEV-27B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: We publish it because the negative result is real and reproducible, and because the comparison belongs in the open. If you want the best model, use SargeDev/Jev_Qwen3.8-27B-Judgment-R32 (or the already-published SargeDev/JEV-27B-Uncensored); if you want the best everyday-chat model, use SargeDev/Jev_Qwen3.8-27B-Judgment (the solar build).
